newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower on short-covering.

text.p: Despite an early rise linked to Taiwan's booming stock market, the Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Monday on banks' short-covering of the American currency, dealers said.
The local dollar finished at T$27.490 against Saturday's T$27.487 close. Turnover through dealers was US$171.5 million.

Despite the U.S. dollar's persistent strength overseas, the Taiwan dollar rose to US$27.483 at one stage as many foreign funds sold the U.S. dollar to raise local cash to plough into the island's stock market, which resumed a bull run on Monday.
The local unit's rise did not last.
